\begin{table*}[t]
\caption{Attitude-stream tracking across the four named maneuvers: bank-angle RMSE in degrees, the interquartile mean over the runs that stayed inside the flight envelope with its 95\% bootstrap interval. A superscript counts the runs that departed; a dash with a superscript marks a cell where every run departed. All five methods drive the identical $(\phi^\star,\dot h^\star,V_a^\star)$ stream through the same plant. The learned methods are flown once per training seed, five seeds. MPPI has no seeds, but a single rollout is one draw, so it is flown five times with different sampling seeds. The LQR is a deterministic law and is flown once. One of five SAC training seeds departed on the Airship~V7 helix, and two of five SAC training seeds departed on the Airship~V7 s-turn.}
